An empty data_as_elements list turns data-as off

```php title="PHP"
<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

require_once __DIR__ . '/vendor/autoload.php';

use HtmlToMarkdown\HtmlToMarkdown;
use HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions;
$options = \HtmlToMarkdown\ConversionOptions::from_json(json_encode(["dataAsElements" => []]));
$result = HtmlToMarkdown::convert("<div><span data-as=\"p\">First</span><span data-as=\"p\">Second</span></div>", $options);
var_dump($result->content);
```
